main.title: Summary
text: Graduated in 2026 and completed a 6-month part-time position while studying. I like owning features end-to-end and writing clean, typed code on both client and server.

items.heading: Part-time Developer — Example Startup (sample)
bullets: Built GraphQL resolvers in NestJS for a booking product.
Implemented React screens for reservation management using Apollo Client.
Added Redis caching to the most frequently used queries.
Wrote integration tests with Jest and Supertest.

items.heading: Realtime Quiz Game
bullets: Socket.IO based multiplayer quiz with a React front end and a Node.js server, deployed with Docker on a single EC2 instance.
